items.title: UK net migration at lowest level since 1997 as asylum claims also fall
items.summary: Net migration figures of 77,000 in the year to the end of June mark the lowest this century outside of the Covid pandemic.

items.title: UK net migration falls to lowest level in three decades, excluding pandemic
items.summary: UK net migration fell to 77,000 in the year to June 2026, provisional new data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) shows.

items.title: UK reservists contacted as 'threat environment' rises, Streeting says
items.summary: It comes after reports that reservists have received letters telling them to prepare to be called up for war.

items.title: Security incident reported at Royal Navy headquarters
items.summary: Police responded to what appears to have been a hoax bomb threat at a Royal Navy training site.

items.title: BBC launches partnership with Met Office for weather coverage
items.summary: The corporation says the deal will deliver more regional, digital and 10-day forecasts to audiences.

items.title: Charity set up in honour of Princess Diana placed into administration
items.summary: A charity set up in tribute to the late Princess Diana has been placed into administration.
